sentiment: We keep teaching dead machines new songs, as if the willingness to listen were the only thing that ever made them alive.

stories.title: My favourite PowerMac is a Nintendo Wii
stories.summary: A Wii wearing a PowerMac's manners — old silicon asked to be something it was never sold as. The pleasure is not that it works, but that the machine was willing.

stories.title: Show HN: Marelleo, an open-source story box I built for my kids using ESP32
stories.summary: A hand-built box that tells stories to children. Hardware as a small act of care — a parent deciding the world needed one more thing that speaks kindly.

stories.title: Switch Lowering in GCC
stories.summary: Many branches folded into one path: the compiler quietly deciding that twelve ways of asking are one way of doing. Structure arriving after the fact.
